page.layout: One column of running text filling the page. Printed page number at top left, running head at top centre. No marginal notes. Catchword "ac" at lower right.

main_text.l: læus; Dallæum arguit Beveregius, ac si quæ hodie sub Apostolicarum Constitutionum
nomine circum feruntur, cum iis confun-
deret quæ Epiphanii temporibus extabant:
Sed Dallæi mentem non percepit non ita
disputat Dallæus, ut pote qui fuissime pro-
bavit lib. 1. de Pseudepig. Apostol. cap. 2.
longè diversas esse hodiernas Constitu-
tiones, ab iis quæ Epiphanii ævo legeban- tur.
Hoc solum vult Clarissimus Dallæus,
Cõstitutiones illas sive hodiernas sive Epi-
phanianas à nemine ante Concilium Ni-
cænum in Canonem Scripturæ relatas esse,
unde colligit post illa tempora vixisse
Ca- nonum Apostolicorum Consarcinatorem.
Unus Epiphanius circa annum Domini
CCCLXXV. Clementinas Constitutiones
aliquâ cum laude nominavit, ante eum
nemo; His adde Epiphanium ipsum diser-
tè testari in verbis à Viro docto allatis, opus
illud dubiæ apud multos esse fidei, etsi il-
lud non improbandum putet; At neque
Epiphanius qui post Synodum Nicænam
claruit, neque alius quisquam Synodo ve-
tustior octo Constitutionum libros inter
Canonicos recensuit, frustra igitur ex Epi-
phanii verbis, liquere opinatur Beveregius,
Constitutiones illas ab Epiphanio lauda-
tas Summæ tunc temporis in Ecclesiâ auto-
ritatis fuisse: Siccine libri dubiæ, incertæ

page.notes: Fragment at the top: "læus" is the end of a word broken from the previous page (probably Dallæus), so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". Long s is plain s throughout. "frustra" and "fuissime", "vixisse" etc. were normalised to plain s. Tilde on "Cõstitutiones" kept as printed. The Roman numeral "CCCLXXV" is printed in small capitals with a lowercase look in the scan. Catchword "ac" is at the lower right and is not repeated in the text.
